summary: This directory manages the definition and testing infrastructure for application-specific error types. It ensures that custom error classes are correctly implemented, maintain standard behaviors, and fulfill requirements for error handling across the codebase.
responsibilities: Defining custom error classes for domain-specific failures
Validating error class construction and behavior
Ensuring consistency in error reporting across the application
relationships: Schema validation errors extend the base error class to provide specific context for validation failures.
Test files verify that custom error classes properly capture and report error information as expected by the application.
designDecisions: Inheritance hierarchy for shared error characteristics
Isolated testing of error classes to verify construction
Separation of error definitions from business logic
